notes: Syria has no VAT. Indirect taxation is via the consumption spending tax (ضريبة الإنفاق الاستهلاكي), a selective tax levied at varying rates on specified goods and services (e.g. tourist restaurants and hotels, certain luxury/imported goods), not a general multi-stage tax with input credit. In 2025 the Ministry of Finance's tax reform committee published drafts of a new Income Tax Law and a Sales Tax Law, to replace the consumption spending tax and intended to apply from early 2026 (press reports; draft art. 9 would let the finance minister adjust the rate annually within limits). Whether the Sales Tax Law was enacted and its rate could not be confirmed; if enacted it would likely qualify as a general consumption tax and this record should be revised.
